text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
One look at your face tells me all I need 
to know. You want a tandem run, right? 
Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it. I'm just passing along 
a message from the trainer—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. A summons, then. I shall go at 
once.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's not like you're in trouble. It's 
about the homework given today—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I've already finished that. I started the 
moment it was handed to me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Apparently the study scope was wrong. 
They asked me to pass that along.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Gah!! How could this be...! Just 
because... I was too fast...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Once again. The scope of the homework has 
changed. The correct details are posted in 
the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Correction to homework range. Correct one 
is in class. Thanks! Got it completely.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...Teacher said, "Only you can do this," 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it, as long as you don't give up 
and keep trying to communicate,\nyou can 
reach an understanding with anyone...)
